summary: Carousel of four procedural pixel scenes with an ordered-dither dissolve between slides; autoplay pauses on hover or focus.

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: Presence attribute. Advances every 5 s, draws a progress line along the bottom and shows a button that stops and starts the rotation. Pauses while hovered, focused or off-screen. Observed, so it can be added or removed at any time.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the slide changes, by user action or autoplay. `index` is zero-based.

methods.description: Shows the slide at `index`; values outside 0–3 wrap around.

accessibility: The slide area is a focusable `role="region"` with `aria-roledescription="carousel"` and `aria-label="Pixel scenes"`.
The canvas has `role="img"` and an `aria-label` such as `Slide 1 of 4: Aurora over the ridge`.
The caption is an `aria-live` region: `polite` after a change by the user, `off` while autoplay rotates the slides.
Previous and Next buttons have `aria-label`s; dot buttons are labelled `Slide <n>: <title>`, and the current one has `aria-current="true"`.
With `autoplay`, a button labelled Stop autoplay or Start autoplay stops and restarts the rotation; autoplay also pauses while the slide area is hovered or holds focus.
motion: With reduced motion, autoplay does not advance, slides switch without the dissolve and the scenes are static.
notes: The four scenes are generated in code and cannot be replaced.
A horizontal swipe of more than 40px changes the slide. The image is 210px tall and fills the width.

data.note: The four slides, generated scenes with built-in captions, cannot be replaced; nothing can be set.
